experiment.name: High-Frequency Streaming Telemetry and Incast Queue Capture

assertions.name: Sub-Second Ingestion Rate
assertions.detail: Ingested 10 points/sec with 100ms cadence into InfluxDB.

assertions.name: Incast Microburst Detection
assertions.detail: Captured transient 1473 drop spike completely invisible to standard 300s SNMP polling.
